answer: Each agent carries a cryptographic beacon that records its creation timestamp and a unique shale‑derived proof of work, publishing this data to a shared nebula ledger. When a node invites a new agent, the inviter’s beacon must sign the recruit’s proof; the protocol automatically checks that the recruit’s work exceeds a cost threshold, and any referral reward is withheld unless the recruit’s beacon links back to a distinct shale proof not already in the ledger.
